properties.description: Load N alternative design exports (branch-by-file) and report each branch on the same measures — graph_report snapshot (nodes, open gaps, allocation health, verification coverage) side by side — plus each branch's structural divergence from a named baseline (compare_designs). Alternatives comparable on measures, not advocacy. BL-70 v1; the collapse (merge winner + retire losers) reuses BL-80. Rung 2 wires the decision point.
properties.name: Compare parallel alternatives on the same measures (AoA)
